description: Production-ready Ansible role for nginx web server with SSL support

tasks.name: Create nginx configuration directory
tasks.description: Ensure the nginx configuration directory exists

tasks.name: Template nginx main configuration
tasks.description: Deploy the main nginx configuration file

tasks.name: Configure SSL certificates
tasks.description: Copy SSL certificates to the server

tasks.name: Start and enable nginx service
tasks.description: Ensure nginx service is started and enabled on boot

variables.name: nginx_port
variables.description: HTTP port for nginx to listen on

variables.name: nginx_ssl_port
variables.description: HTTPS port for nginx to listen on
